target.title: fix(google): bound embedding batch file upload error body read
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`response.text()` in the Gemini batch file upload error path read the
response body unbounded into memory and embedded it in the Error message.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced manual `response.ok` check + `response.text()` + `throw Error`
with `assertOkOrThrowProviderError`, which provides bounded reads, redaction,
and structured `ProviderHttpError` metadata — following #102953 (steipete).

## User Impact

**Before:** unbounded `response.text()` + raw body in error message
**After:** bounded via `assertOkOrThrowProviderError` with redacted metadata

## Evidence

### Targeted path proof (Gemini file upload via assertOkOrThrowProviderError)

Real HTTP 400 with sensitive Google API error body → `assertOkOrThrowProviderError(response, "gemini.batch-file-upload")`:

```
=== #103306 Proof: assertOkOrThrowProviderError on Gemini file upload path ===
Error thrown: PASS
ProviderHttpError instance: PASS
Error name ProviderHttpError: PASS
Status 400: PASS
Label "gemini.batch-file-upload": PASS
API_KEY_INVALID not leaked: PASS
Service domain not leaked: PASS
Raw JSON not leaked: PASS
Structured code INVALID_ARGUMENT: PASS

Message: gemini.batch-file-upload (400): The API key included in the request is invalid. [code=INVALID_ARGUMENT]
Code: INVALID_ARGUMENT
Status: 400

Overall: ALL PASS
```

### Tests

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google/embedding-batch.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
```

### Diff

```

```

- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
